headline: Licensed, credentialed, and held to a professional standard.
intro: When you book with Time 4U, you're in the hands of a licensed therapist with years of training and real clinical experience.

items.title: License
items.body: Licensed Massage Therapist (L.M.T.), Oklahoma license #{license}, issued by the Oklahoma Board of Cosmetology and Barbering.

items.title: Education
items.body: Certified in Massage Therapy from Platt College (2008). Previously licensed in Cosmetology.

items.title: Professional Membership
items.body: Member of Associated Bodywork & Massage Professionals (ABMP), a national standard for professional, ethical practice.

items.title: Certifications & Training
items.body: Certified in Breast Massage; trained in reflexology, cupping, myofascial release, craniosacral therapy, waxing/sugaring, ear candling, and essential oils & aromatherapy.

note: Your care matters. Clara keeps a professional standard of safety, comfort, and informed treatment.
ctaBody: Clara is happy to talk through whether massage is right for you.
